registryAssessment: Montes Claros has a locally administered Cadastro Imobiliário under the municipal Secretaria Municipal de Finanças (SEFIN). The official municipal digital-maps announcement describes public cadastral lots/blocks and property consultation; the municipal decree defines cadastral records for territorial parcels and a numeric Índice Cadastral. This is local municipal registry evidence, not proof of an open parcel API.

portalsFound.observation: Official SEFIN announcement for a digital map platform; lists quadras e lotes and says citizens can consult imóveis, lotes e edificações. The page contains no map iframe, service URL, WMS/WFS, ArcGIS endpoint, or API configuration.

Official municipal decree regulates the Cadastro Imobiliário, covering parcels, buildings, improvements, ownership/possession and location; it defines the numeric Índice Cadastral. No public geometry service is linked.

Project page from the named SIG contractor describes historical municipal cadastral GIS work, including vectorized lots and stable cadastral-unit keying; it is contextual evidence, not a current public service endpoint.
